# Deplai booking demo

> A working demo of a meeting-booking app at {{siteUrl}}. It exists to show
> what Deplai ({{mainSiteUrl}}) puts online and keeps running: an app of the kind an AI
> tool writes for a small business, deployed on a real address, in Estonian and English.
> Nothing booked here is real: no meeting takes place, no email is sent, and every
> booking is archived overnight, freeing the calendar. To actually talk to Deplai, email {{contactEmail}}.

## What this app is
- A live demonstration: the kind of app a hairdresser, coach or repair shop would use to take bookings
- Modelled on booking a 20-minute call with Deplai, but it is a sandbox: real conversations are arranged by email
- Built with AI tooling, deployed and maintained by Deplai on a server in the European Union
- Source code: https://github.com/deplaiou/deplai-booking

## What a visitor can do
1. Pick a day, then a free time: weekdays, 09:00-15:00 Estonian time (Europe/Tallinn), slots every 30 minutes for a 20-minute call, up to 10 working days ahead, minimum 2 hours' notice
2. Fill in name, email, the topic of the call and optional notes
3. Get a booking reference on screen, plus a reminder that it was a demo and an email link for a real conversation

## What it does not do
- It does not send an automatic confirmation email; the booking reference is shown on the page
- It does not take payments and asks for no payment details
- In demo mode every booking is archived nightly at 03:00 UTC, so the calendar starts empty each day

## How it is built
- Nuxt 4 (Vue 3) with server-side rendering, so every page is readable without JavaScript
- Nitro server routes for the API; MariaDB (mysql2) as the only datastore
- Double booking is prevented by a UNIQUE key on the start time of live bookings, not by application logic
- Posted times are validated against the generated slot list, so a handcrafted time is rejected
- Two languages from one codebase via @nuxtjs/i18n: Estonian at "/", English at "/en"
- The app runs as one container next to the database; 0.5 CPU and 256 MB is enough for it
